high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news post from WION News on Instagram. The post features an aerial view of several naval ships sailing in the South China Sea. The ships include what appears to be a large aircraft carrier at the center, surrounded by smaller warships. The text overlay on the image reads: "India deploys warships in South China Sea as part of 'Act East' policy." This indicates that India has sent its naval forces into the region as a strategic move under its "Act East" policy. The mood of the image is serious and informative, reflecting the geopolitical nature of the content.
